usage.status: status                 the switch, the identity and the endpoints
usage.preflight: preflight              check, without the network, that only the person's step is left
usage.switch: on | off               turn the cloud line on or off in the settings file
usage.commands: commands on | off      whether a paired viewer may act on this machine; off by default
usage.login: login [--wait 10m]     register this machine and wait for the approval
usage.pair: pair [--offer <code>]  show a browser a one-time link, or finish with its code
usage.devices: devices                who may speak to this machine, and where that trust came from
usage.revoke: revoke <device-id>     throw one browser out of this machine
usage.rotate: rotate [--yes]         replace this machine's signing key; every browser re-pairs
usage.connect: connect [--for 1m]     hold the line open and report what happens
commands.allowed: a paired viewer may now type into this machine's sessions
login.wait_help: how long to wait for the approval
login.name_help: what to call this machine; defaults to the hostname
login.verified: verified   the control plane issued a device token (expires %s)
login.next: next       clawdline cloud on, then restart the daemon
preflight.network: network    nothing in this check was sent anywhere
connect.for_help: how long to hold the line; 0 means until interrupted
connect.publish_help: a channel to publish one test envelope on
connect.repeat_help: re-send the published envelope's exact bytes N more times, to show the relay's answer to a duplicate
connect.json_help: print the final status as JSON
connect.unknown_channel: %q is not a channel this build knows
connect.republished: cloud re-published the identical bytes seq=%d (attempt %d)
pair.offer_help: finish a pairing with the code the browser is showing
pair.wait_help: how long to wait for a browser
pair.open_1: Open this on the browser you want to pair, signed in to the same
pair.machine_key: This machine's key is %s. The browser shows the same one when it finishes.
pair.waiting: Waiting… (Ctrl-C stops waiting; the link keeps working until it expires)
pair.timeout: clawdline: nothing answered that link in time
pair.access: that browser can now read and, if commands are on, drive this machine
pair.failed: clawdline: the pairing did not complete: %s
devices.none: no browser has been paired with this machine
devices.pair_hint: run `clawdline cloud pair` to show one a link
revoke.no_change: nothing changed: %s was not a browser this machine had pinned
revoke.refusal: its next envelope is refused here, whatever the account's list says
rotate.warning_1: Rotating this machine's signing key makes these browsers stop being able to
rotate.warning_2: verify this machine. Each one has to be paired again:
rotate.none: No browser has been paired with this machine, so nothing has to be repaired.
rotate.reconnecting: the line went down and is coming back on the new key
